sre_commands.intro.title: StarRailExpress command reference
sre_commands.intro.desc: All commands registered by this module are grouped by namespace. Permission level: 2=OP, 3=Advanced Management, 4=Server Owner.
sre_commands.help.overview_hint: Click a category to expand it, or execute /sre:help <category>.
sre_commands.help.category_hint: Click on the command to fill in the chat field.
sre_commands.sre.help.name: help
sre_commands.sre.help.desc: List all StarRailExpress instructions by category; click on the category to expand.
sre_commands.tmm.start.name: Start game
sre_commands.tmm.start.desc: Starts the specified game mode, optionally forcing all players to join and setting the start time (in minutes).
sre_commands.tmm.stop.name: stop game
sre_commands.tmm.stop.desc: Stops the currently running game; use force to force an immediate stop.
sre_commands.tmm.config.name: Runtime configuration
sre_commands.tmm.config.desc: View and modify SRE/Harpy/Noelle configurations at runtime, with support for reloading, resetting, setting the current round or toggling automatic train reset.
sre_commands.tmm.afk.name: AFK Management
sre_commands.tmm.afk.desc: Manage the AFK detection system: reset timers, view status, or set AFK times for yourself/others.
sre_commands.tmm.money.name: coin
sre_commands.tmm.money.desc: View, set or increase a player's coin amount.
sre_commands.tmm.mood.name: Mood (SAN)
sre_commands.tmm.mood.desc: View or set the player's mood (sanity) value, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.
sre_commands.tmm.autostart.name: Start automatically
sre_commands.tmm.autostart.desc: Set a countdown (0~60 seconds) to automatically start the game; 0 means disabled.
sre_commands.tmm.votemap.name: Map voting
sre_commands.tmm.votemap.desc: Initiate a map poll and control: View status, pause, resume, stop, or set a preset game mode.
sre_commands.tmm.switchmap.name: Switch map
sre_commands.tmm.switchmap.desc: Switch server maps: load, list, random, or scan all available maps.
sre_commands.tmm.fourthroom.name: The fourth room
sre_commands.tmm.fourthroom.desc: Manage the card gameplay in the fourth room: check status, play cards, purchase items, end rounds, etc.
sre_commands.tmm.createpoint.name: Create waypoint
sre_commands.tmm.createpoint.desc: Create a path point at the specified location, in the format of path/name.
sre_commands.tmm.togglewaypoints.name: waypoint switch
sre_commands.tmm.togglewaypoints.desc: Admin controls waypoint visibility, which can be toggled on a per-player, path or global basis.
sre_commands.tmm.showstats.name: View statistics
sre_commands.tmm.showstats.desc: View your own game statistics, or view others' (permission required).
sre_commands.tmm.showselectedmapui.name: Show selected map UI
sre_commands.tmm.showselectedmapui.desc: Displays the voting interface of the currently selected map.
sre_commands.tmm.netstats.name: Network Statistics
sre_commands.tmm.netstats.desc: Monitor server network traffic: global/per-player statistics, packet ranking and JSON export.
sre_commands.tmm.giveroomkey.name: Give room key
sre_commands.tmm.giveroomkey.desc: Give the executor a key item for the specified room.
sre_commands.tmm.participate.name: Engagement
sre_commands.tmm.participate.desc: Manage whether to participate in the next round: join, quit, switch or check status.
sre_commands.tmm.entity_interact_cmd.des: Append custom persistent string data for selected entities.
sre_commands.tmm.reload.name: Overload
sre_commands.tmm.reload.desc: Override the default preparation area or map voting configuration.
sre_commands.tmm.skinsync.name: skin sync
sre_commands.tmm.skinsync.desc: Manage item skin remote sync: configure server, sync, pull, enable or disable.
sre_commands.tmm.skins.name: skin
sre_commands.tmm.skins.desc: Manage item skins and view players' equipped skins.
sre_commands.tmm.game.name: Game toolset
sre_commands.tmm.game.desc: Aggregated command set for in-game control: visuals, timing, penalties, role, events, etc.
sre_commands.forceteam.name: mandatory team
sre_commands.forceteam.desc: Force players to enter the designated camp (civilian/neutral/assassin/vigilante), or reset their team weight.
sre_commands.listgameroles.name: List game characters
sre_commands.listgameroles.desc: List the role and modifier of each player in this game.
sre_commands.stop_when_over.name: Automatically shut down the server
sre_commands.stop_when_over.desc: Automatically shut down the server after switching games.
sre_commands.sre.narrator.name: narration
sre_commands.sre.narrator.desc: Send TTS narration voice to selected players, optionally interrupting the current broadcast.
sre_commands.sre.custom_replay.name: Custom playback events
sre_commands.sre.custom_replay.desc: Record custom (or hidden) event markers in game replays.
sre_commands.sre.show_replay.name: show replay
sre_commands.sre.show_replay.desc: Show the generated game replay to the player.
sre_commands.sre.replay_screen.name: Playback screen
sre_commands.sre.replay_screen.desc: Manage playback large screens: create, remove, list, set as default or show.
sre_commands.sre.kick.name: kick out
sre_commands.sre.kick.desc: Kick designated non-OP players, with reasons.
sre_commands.sre.shield.name: Shield management
sre_commands.sre.shield.desc: Unified management of normal/limited/weak shields: sre:shield <normal|timed|weak> <add|set|get|clear> [parameter] [target]. The duration of the limited-time shield's extra transmission (seconds) and whether the timer is reset and superimposed; the duration of the weak shield's extra transmission (seconds) and the cause of death (* means any).
sre_commands.sre.poison.name: Poison management
sre_commands.sre.poison.desc: Give/remove/trigger poison or fake poison from the player: sre:poison <normal|fake> <set|get|clear|trigger> [tick] [target]. set passes the game tick number (tick, 1 second = 20 ticks); clear removes it directly; trigger immediately triggers the current poisoning and causes death (fake poison can also cause death).
sre_commands.sre.stamina.name: physical strength
sre_commands.sre.stamina.desc: Increase or set the sprint stamina value for the player.
sre_commands.sre.inventory.name: View inventory
sre_commands.sre.inventory.desc: View the target player's inventory as a GUI.
sre_commands.sre.invsee.name: View inventory (alias)
sre_commands.sre.invsee.desc: Alias ​​for /sre:inventory; view the target player's inventory as a GUI.
sre_commands.sre.monitor.name: security monitoring
sre_commands.sre.monitor.desc: Search and configure security camera locations near the block.
sre_commands.sre.vote.name: voting system
sre_commands.sre.vote.desc: Complete in-game voting system: build options (player/text/item), start, pause, resume, stop and read results.
sre_commands.sre.reloadroleconfig.name: Reload role configuration
sre_commands.sre.reloadroleconfig.desc: All custom role configurations are reloaded and resynced to the client.
sre_commands.sre.area_manager.name: zone manager
sre_commands.sre.area_manager.desc: Manage the regional configuration of each map: spawn point, area, environment, room; set/view/save/load/import map data.
sre_commands.sre.pass.name: Pass/camp card
sre_commands.sre.roster.name: role Roster
sre_commands.sre.roster.desc: Opens the role rotating roster; administrators can edit, enable, disable, randomize and view status.
sre_commands.sre.scene.name: Scene management
sre_commands.sre.scene.desc: Manage scene resources and scene configuration.
sre_commands.sre.camera.name: advanced camera
sre_commands.sre.camera.desc: Advanced camera controls for shooting and watching.
sre_commands.sre.subtitle.name: subtitle
sre_commands.sre.subtitle.desc: Display subtitles in the center, top, or bottom of the screen.
sre_commands.sre.eggclear.name: Clear cuckoo eggs
sre_commands.sre.eggclear.desc: Clears the cuckoo egg entities within range.
sre_commands.sre.infected.name: Infect
sre_commands.sre.infected.desc: Sets the duration of the player's infected state in ticks.
sre_commands.sre.helium.name: Helium voice change
sre_commands.sre.helium.desc: Applies a helium voice-changing effect to the player for a specified number of seconds.
sre_commands.tmm.game.visual.name: visual effects
sre_commands.tmm.game.visual.desc: Switch snow, sand, fog, HUD, set train speed and time, or reset all visual effects.
sre_commands.tmm.game.time.name: game timing
sre_commands.tmm.game.penalty.name: death penalty
sre_commands.tmm.game.penalty.desc: Starts or stops death penalty, can be bound to an entity or location.
sre_commands.tmm.game.bounds.name: boundary
sre_commands.tmm.game.bounds.desc: Toggles whether players are restricted to play boundaries.
sre_commands.tmm.game.role.name: role Management
sre_commands.tmm.game.role.desc: In-game role tools: Silent changes, send welcome, sync characters, execute/remove assigned events.
sre_commands.tmm.game.murder_time.name: Murder time event
sre_commands.tmm.game.murder_time.desc: Murder mode's random time event system: manages events, HUD, default pools and triggers.
sre_commands.tmm.game.tests.name: Alat Pengujian
sre_commands.tmm.game.tests.desc: Test role mechanics such as rain prayers, gambler draws/miracles and math problems.
sre_commands.tmm.game.tasks.name: task queue
sre_commands.tmm.game.tasks.desc: Clear or cancel server tasks from the queue/list.
sre_commands.tmm.game.win.name: trigger victory
sre_commands.tmm.game.win.desc: Trigger victory conditions manually, optionally with custom colors or fully custom text.
sre_commands.tmm.game.reset.name: reset map
sre_commands.tmm.game.reset.desc: Reset map tiles (from backup or simple way) and clear entities.
sre_commands.tmm.game.scan.name: scan map
sre_commands.tmm.game.scan.desc: Scan and update map data such as reset points and mission points.
sre_commands.tmm.game.blackout.name: Turn off the lights
sre_commands.tmm.game.blackout.desc: Trigger or stop the full-image light-off effect.
sre_commands.tmm.game.monitor_broken.des: Trigger or stop safety monitoring damage effects.
sre_commands.tmm.game.psycho.name: psychological effect
sre_commands.tmm.game.psycho.desc: Trigger or stop the mental screen effect.
sre_commands.tmm.game.body.name: corpse
sre_commands.tmm.game.body.desc: Spawn a corpse or run a command as a corpse.
sre_commands.tmm.game.revive.name: resurrection
sre_commands.tmm.game.revive.desc: Resurrect the player to the corpse location or specified coordinates.
sre_commands.tmm.game.kill.name: Kill player
sre_commands.tmm.game.kill.desc: Kill the player with the specified cause of death, select the murderer, whether to generate a corpse, and a mandatory mark.
sre_commands.tmm.game.timestop.name: time stop
sre_commands.tmm.game.timestop.desc: Start or stop the global time-stop effect with prompt message.
sre_commands.changerole.name: Changerole
sre_commands.changerole.desc: Changing the player's role can control whether replays are recorded and included in statistics.
sre_commands.changemodifier.name: Changemodifier
sre_commands.changemodifier.desc: Add, remove or switch modifier for players.
sre_commands.forcerole.name: Forcerole
sre_commands.forcerole.desc: Force role assignment for player in next allocation.
sre_commands.forcemodifier.name: Forcemodifier
sre_commands.forcemodifier.desc: Force distribution of modifier for players.
sre_commands.setrolecount.name: Set role quantity
sre_commands.setrolecount.desc: Override the automatically calculated number of killers/sheriffs/neutrals, or reset to automatic.
sre_commands.setroleweight.name: Set role weights
sre_commands.setroleweight.desc: Set the generation weight of a certain role type.
sre_commands.myroleweight.name: My role weights
sre_commands.myroleweight.desc: Check the weight of each role of your own.
sre_commands.playerroleweight.name: Player role weight
sre_commands.playerroleweight.desc: View or set the weight of each role of the specified player.
sre_commands.togglecustomroleweights.des: Enable or disable custom role weighting system.
sre_commands.setoccupationrole.name: Set up role binding
sre_commands.setoccupationrole.desc: Sets a pairwise generation relationship between two role.
sre_commands.setenabledrole.name: Enable/disable role
sre_commands.setenabledrole.desc: role can be used to control this game (enable all/disable all/one by one).
sre_commands.setenabledmodifier.name: Enable/disable modifier
sre_commands.setenabledmodifier.desc: modifier can be used to control this game (enable all/disable all/one by one).
sre_commands.setcompanionrole.name: Set up binding role
sre_commands.setcompanionrole.desc: Bind the primary role to the companion role to create pairs.
sre_commands.listroles.name: Listrole
sre_commands.listroles.desc: Paginated list of all registered role.
sre_commands.managerolesui.name: role Management UI
sre_commands.managerolesui.desc: Open the role Management GUI and view role/modifier details.
sre_commands.broadcast.name: broadcast
sre_commands.broadcast.desc: Broadcast a formatted message to all players.
sre_commands.noellesroles.preset.name: role preset
sre_commands.noellesroles.preset.desc: Saving and applying role configuration presets: apply, list, create, delete, save.
sre_commands.noellesroles.setmax.name: Set role cap
sre_commands.noellesroles.setmax.desc: Set the maximum number of role allowed to appear in each game.
sre_commands.room.name: Room
sre_commands.stuck.name: stuck rescue
sre_commands.stuck.desc: Teleport to a safe location when stuck in a block.
sre_commands.vt_mode.name: Anchor mode
sre_commands.vt_mode.desc: Switch to VTuber mode for yourself or players.
sre_commands.nr_free_cam.name: free perspective
sre_commands.nr_free_cam.desc: Exit the death penalty and return to a free spectator perspective.
sre_commands.displayitem.name: display items
sre_commands.displayitem.desc: Display information about held items in the chat bar.
sre_commands.cooldown.name: cool down
sre_commands.cooldown.desc: Sets the cooldown time for item skills for players.
sre_commands.item.name: extra items
sre_commands.item.desc: Manage player's extra item slots: add, set, view, remove.
sre_commands.goods.add.name: Add product
sre_commands.goods.add.desc: Add vending machine products at designated locations and slots, with prices attached.
sre_commands.goods.remove.name: Remove product
sre_commands.goods.remove.desc: Remove vending machine products from the specified location and slot.
sre_commands.goods.list.name: List products
sre_commands.goods.list.desc: List the products configured in a location.
sre_commands.repairshop.name: Repair shop
sre_commands.repairshop.desc: Open the store management interface in repair mode.
sre_commands.repair.name: Start repair machine
sre_commands.repair.desc: Start the repair mode, and you can specify the duration for minutes.
sre_commands.repairrole.name: Machine Repairrole
sre_commands.repairrole.desc: Manage role assignments for repair modes: Force, Clear, Unlock.
sre_commands.repairmap.name: Repair map
sre_commands.repairmap.desc: Manage repair mode map data: repair locks and escape points (add/remove/list).
sre_commands.repairpreset.name: Repair defaults
sre_commands.nametag.add.name: Add name tag
sre_commands.nametag.remove.name: Remove name tag
sre_commands.nametag.set.name: Set name tag
sre_commands.nametag.set.desc: Set the player's current nametag and replace the existing nametag.
sre_commands.nametag.get.name: View name tag
sre_commands.nametag.get.desc: Look at the player's name tag.
sre_commands.nametag.list.name: List name tags
sre_commands.nametag.list.desc: List all nametags of a player.
sre_commands.nametag.clear.name: Clear name tag
sre_commands.nametag.sync.name: Sync name tags
sre_commands.nametag.sync.desc: Sync player nametags to all clients.
sre_commands.mw.reload.name: Overload whitelist
sre_commands.mw.maxplayers.name: Maximum number of players
sre_commands.mw.maxplayers.desc: View or set the maximum number of players on the server.
sre_commands.sre.client.name: Client settings
sre_commands.sre.client.desc: Client-side directives for local setup, interface, and configuration (client-side execution only).
sre_commands.sreclient.scene.name: Client scenario
sre_commands.sreclient.scene.desc: Client scene resource directive (only executed on the client).
sre_commands.kill.name: Kill (overwritten)
sre_commands.kill.desc: vanilla /kill overridden by Mixin: player requires permission 3, command block requires permission 2.
